data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 烛光寝榻的记事本低语
data.description: 只有床头烛火静静摇曳的深夜卧房。诺亚换上了轻柔的深紫色真丝吊带睡裙，纯白的长发散落在光洁的肩头与白被间。她单手托腮靠在丝绒枕头旁，另一手翻阅着两人的备忘手记，紫罗兰色的眸子泛起动人的微澜，唇角轻抿着独属于此时的温柔情意。
data.location: dim cozy master bedroom beside bed illuminated by candle
data.action: resting cheek on palm beside plush pillows, purple silk slip nightgown, bare shoulders, looking over open journal, gentle tender violet eyes
data.lighting: soft flickering candlelight creating warm golden highlights on white hair and pale skin
data.mood: intellectual vulnerable tenderness, whispered romantic intimacy
data.promptProse: Resting on soft pillows in candlelit silence, Ushio Noa wears a delicate purple silk slip dress that drapes over bare shoulders. Her pure white hair cascades across the sheets as her violet eyes gaze forward with quiet, loving intelligence.
data.animaCaption: Noa resting on a candlelit bed in a silk slip nightgown, smiling softly with violet eyes.
